set_aside.subject: A29 policy representation and invariant landing
set_aside.text: Status says “policy data behind an invariant lives in the rules tables below, not in prose” and the readiness assessment says “All policy tables are rules data, not prose”; changed A29 instead says its normative policy is “this decision's text above” and “There is no `rules` namespace for it.”
set_aside.question: Is A29 an explicit exception whose prose and later operation notes are the sole normative representation, or must its bootstrap and exit-code policy remain materialized as rules data like other State 2 policies?
options: Treat changed A29 as an explicit exception to the Status/readiness claims and rely on its prose plus State 7 notes.
Retain a structured rules-data representation for A29 despite its Consequence.
Revise the Status/readiness claims so they no longer require every invariant-backed policy to live in rules data.
set_aside.default_guess: Treat the later, specific A29 Consequence as an exception and implement its stated behavior directly in the bootstrap operation and CLI notes.
